Suvarna Projects Limited 
 
 Letter of Recommendation 
 
 
 Letter of recommendation 
 
 Our ref: 12 March 31, 2026 
 
 This office has engaged M/s National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. for the work "Lift Irrigation -
 West Bengal Pkg-13" (INR 23.20 Cr), completed on June 4, 2021. On the basis of that engagement
 
 we record the following: 
 
 • Adherence to the sanctioned programme of work and milestone dates;
 • Quality of workmanship accepted at inspection without material objection;
 
 • Compliance with safety and statutory obligations on site; 
 • Responsiveness of the contractor's site management. 
 
 National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. completed the engagement within the sanctioned time and
 
 cost, and their conduct on site was professional throughout. We would consider them for similar
 works. 
 
 Verification: Priti Yadav, ee@dept.gov.in, +91-9830000000. 
 
 
 
 For Suvarna Projects Limited
